public.text: SMART Guidelines personas are presented as a worked example of actor modelling. The text may overstate the degree to which personas are directly represented as computable actor definitions in every corresponding implementation guide.
public.suggestedRevision: Verify the statement against current SMART Guidelines specifications and distinguish human personas, business roles, system actors, and FHIR actor representations.
